verdict: With zero paid spend and no leads recorded in the last 28 days, organic GBP activity is the only traffic source, and it dropped sharply by 58.93% over the past 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a listing visibility issue. The 178 total GBP actions (61 calls, 117 web clicks) over 28 days show some baseline intent, but the steep week-over-week decline warrants an immediate audit of the GBP listing for suppression or category changes.

performance.verdict: Paid ads dark 28+ days; organic decay now the real risk to pipeline.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads for all 28 days in window — Meta and Google both fully dark; $0 of the ~$65–75/day SOW budget is deploying.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31 — no contract governs the next 3 months; all paid activity is gated behind this.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue 2026-08-31 — contact-rate bottleneck (the stated limiting factor) cannot be resolved without these.
GBP actions fell 58.93% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2) show 0, 0, 0 vs prior 3 days (Aug 28–30) of 4, 2, 0 — listing likely suppressed or dark.
GHL shows 16 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in 28 days — intake pipeline is structurally broken regardless of lead volume.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signature immediately — all paid reactivation (~$65/day) is blocked without it.
suggestions.monday_update: The engagement contract lapsed 2026-08-31 and no extension is signed. Zero paid spend ($0 vs ~$65/day SOW budget) has been the result for the entire 28-day window. Success is a countersigned extension in hand; escalate to Sohib/Nacer by 2026-09-05. Until signed, no paid reactivation should be queued.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing for suppression — 0 actions for 3 consecutive days vs 178 over the prior 28 days is anomalous.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 31, Sep 1, and Sep 2 — a confirmed 3-day signal after a 58.93% week-over-week drop. Check for listing suppression, ownership disputes, or category changes in Google Business Profile. Success check: GBP daily actions return above the trailing 28-day average of ~6/day within 7 days of fix. Re-check 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake pipeline — 16 contacts, 0 opportunities created, 0 appointments is a confirmed intake leak, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 16 contacts over 28 days but zero opportunities were created and zero appointments were booked. This is a CRM workflow or access failure (Zoho Voice overdue per F3), not a lead volume issue. Action: Andrew and Joy to audit the contact-to-opportunity automation and confirm Zoho Voice access is live. Success check: opportunity creation rate moves above 0 within the next 7 days. Re-check 2026-09-10.
